parameters.query: INSERT INTO system_jobs (name, type, status, started_at, payload) VALUES ('financial_calc', 'automation', 'running', NOW(), '{}'::jsonb) RETURNING id

SELECT c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(e.expenses, 0) AS expenses, COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(e.expenses, 0) AS profit, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date AS month FROM companies c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_id, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM sales_invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY company_id ) r ON r.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_id, SUM(amount) AS expenses FROM finance_expenses WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', date::date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY company_id ) e ON e.company_id = c.id ORDER BY c.name
UPDATE system_jobs SET status = 'done', completed_at = NOW(), result = '{"pl_updated": true}'::jsonb WHERE name = 'financial_calc' AND status = 'running' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
